title: Why Your Rent Feels So Expensive

scenes.narration: Is your rent getting worse? The data reveals a massive squeeze.

visual.text: Why Your Rent Feels So Expensive

scenes.narration: Since 1990, residential rent prices have surged by 232%.
That means today's rent index is 3.3 times higher than in 1990.
Even in the last five years, rent has climbed by 33%.
The full story is on the channel.

title: The Hidden Truth About Apartment Vacancies

scenes.narration: Why is it so hard to find an apartment? The vacancy data explains it.

visual.text: The Hidden Truth About Apartment Vacancies

scenes.narration: Back in 2009, vacancy rates hit a record high of 11.1%.
But by 2021, availability plummeted to a historic low of 5.6%.
Today, vacancy sits at 7.6%, leaving the market much tighter than it used to be.
Fewer available units mean landlords hold all the power.
The full story is on the channel.

title: Rent vs Income: The Real Affordability Gap

scenes.narration: Why does renting take so much of your paycheck? Let's compare the growth.

visual.text: Rent vs Income: The Real Affordability Gap

scenes.narration: Since 1990, median household income grew by 30% to reach $87,460.
Over that same period, rent prices have surged by 232%.
Rent is climbing much faster than our take-home pay.
It is a structural imbalance that keeps eating your budget.
The full story is on the channel.
